definition_notes: CDS B1 'Grand Total All Students': all full- and part-time UG (including 'all other undergrads enrolled in credit' non-degree students) plus all graduate and professional students, including Another Gender and Unknown columns in 2024-25. Fall 2024 column sums reconcile (UG 18,285 full-time + 520 part-time = 18,805; graduate 10,974 + 7,958 = 18,932). BU's CDS file names are offset by one year from the academic year (cds-2025.pdf = CDS 2024-25, cds-2024.pdf = 2023-24, cds-2023.pdf = 2022-23); the B1 headers state Fall 2024 / Fall 2023 / Fall 2022.
caveats: CDS matches IPEDS: Fall 2023 36,624 vs 36,624; Fall 2022 36,714 vs 36,714.
